observations.body: Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a container of water, and gave it to Hagar, putting it on her shoulder; and gave her the child, and sent…
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: Water runs out while Hagar and the boy move through the wilderness.
observations.label: Water runs out

observations.body: The wilderness exposes Hagar and Ishmael to death before a hidden well is seen.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Genesis 21:12–23 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: The promise of a future remains beside immediate thirst and grief.
payload.title: Hagar and Ishmael in Beersheba
